verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL documents alerts that monitor query results, evaluate conditions, and deliver notifications automatically. That is a genuine condition-to-action rule, but the documented action is limited to notifications on query results. Auto Loader adds event-driven processing that ingests new files as they arrive in cloud storage, but it is not a user-defined rule engine. Missing for 10: general event triggers (e.g., job/file-arrival or table-change triggers), configurable actions beyond notifications, AI-native rule authoring, depth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
